item.title: Cho: "Instability in the Middle East, No One Can Safeguard Security Alone" (조현 “중동 지역 불안정, 혼자 힘으로 안보 지켜낼 수 없어”)
item.description:
Cho: "Instability in the Middle East, No One Can Safeguard Security Alone" (조현 “중동 지역 불안정, 혼자 힘으로 안보 지켜낼 수 없어”)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul stated on the 22nd (local time), "In the midst of global supply chain disruptions, instability in the Middle East, and rapid technological innovation, no country can safeguard its prosperity and security solely through its own efforts." (조현 외교부 장관은 22일(현지 시각) “글로벌 공급망 교란과 중동 지역의 불안정, 급속한 기술 혁신 속에서 어느 나라도 혼자만의 힘으로 번영과 안보를 지켜낼 수 없다”고 말했다.)

At the 29th ASEAN-ROK Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in Manila, the Philippines, Minister Cho emphasized that "ASEAN is a reliable partner" and pledged to strengthen cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), cultural creative industries, and combating transnational crime. (조 장관은 이날 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 제29차 한·아세안 외교장관 회의에서 “아세안은 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너”라며 인공지능(AI), 문화창조산업, 초국가 범죄 대응 등 분야에서 협력을 강화하겠다고 했다.)

Minister Cho remarked, "President Lee Jae-myung has consistently stressed the importance of solidarity among reliable partners, and for Korea, ASEAN is precisely such a partner." (조 장관은 “이재명 대통령은 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너 간 연대의 중요성을 강조해왔고, 한국에게 아세안은 바로 그러한 파트너”라고 했다.)

Minister Cho outlined the implementation plan for the "Korea-ASEAN Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) Vision," centered on the vision of a Contributor enabling dreams and hopes, a Springboard for growth and innovation, and a Partner for peace and stability, and requested support from ASEAN member states. (조 장관은 꿈과 희망을 이루는 조력자(Contributor), 성장과 혁신의 도약대(Springboard), 평화와 안정의 파트너(Partner) 비전을 중심으로 ‘한-아세안 포괄적 전략 동반자 관계(CSP) 비전’의 이행 계획을 설명하고 아세안 회원국들의 지지를 당부했다.)

He particularly noted that Korea would push forward cooperation to build an AI ecosystem and foster research and talent development based on Korea's AI capabilities. Additionally, he introduced the Cultural Creative Industries Initiative and joint efforts against scam crimes as key cooperative projects. (특히 한국의 AI 역량을 바탕으로 AI 생태계 구축과 연구·인재 양성을 위한 협력을 추진해 나갈 것이라고 했다. 또 문화 창조 산업 이니셔티브와 스캠(사기) 범죄 공동 대응도 주요 협력 사업으로 소개했다.)

ASEAN member states welcomed the "Korea-ASEAN CSP Vision" proposed by President Lee Jae-myung at the ASEAN Summit in October of last year, and expressed their hope to cooperate closely with Korea in the specific implementation process going forward. (아세안 회원국들은 지난해 10월 아세안 정상회의에서 이재명 대통령이 제시한 ‘한·아세안 CSP 비전’을 환영하며, 향후 구체적인 이행 과정에서 한국과 긴밀히 협력해 나가기를 희망한다고 했다.)

Minister Cho also explained the Korean government's efforts to realize a Korean Peninsula where the two Koreas coexist peacefully and grow together, and ASEAN member states reaffirmed their support for the government's policy on the Korean Peninsula. (조 장관은 또 남북이 평화롭게 공존하고 함께 성장하는 한반도를 구현하기 위한 우리 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 아세안 회원국들은 정부의 한반도 정책에 대한 지지를 재확인했다.)

item.title: [Episode 30] Lily with Deadly Poison ([30화] 치명적인 독을 품은 백합)
item.description:
[Episode 30] Lily with Deadly Poison ([30화] 치명적인 독을 품은 백합)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Twenty years ago, Michelle was swimming in a sea of numbers every day in a corner of a shipping company office in the back alleys of Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. (20년 전 미셸은 홍콩 침사추이 뒷골목의 해운회사 사무실 구석에서 매일같이 숫자의 늪을 헤엄쳤다.)

The fan on the fifth floor of the old building spun uselessly twenty-four hours a day. The stale smell of leftover beef noodle soup mixed with the cheap cigarette smoke from the male employees and seeped into the wallpaper. (낡은 건물 5층의 환풍기는 24시간 내내 헛돌았다. 먹다 남은 우육면의 퀘퀘한 냄새는 남자 직원들이 피워대는 싸구려 담배 연기와 뒤엉켜 벽지에 찌들었다.)

Michelle is Hakka. A historical outsider in China, a resilient people who tenaciously survive even on barren land. For a female employee with only a high school diploma who never set foot in a university, the only space allowed was a cramped desk buried under mountains of bills of lading, non-negotiable cargo receipts, and finicky customs documents. (미셸은 객가인이다. 중국의 역사적 이방인이자, 척박한 땅에서도 악착같이 살아남는 생활력 강한 민족. 대학 문턱을 밟아보지 못한 고졸 여직원에게 허락된 공간은, 산더미처럼 쌓인 선하증권과 면책화물인수증, 까다로운 세관 서류들 사이의 비좁은 책상뿐이었다.)

Her daily routine was meticulously filling out the documents that the male employees had tossed aside, claiming they were "too much of a headache." But Michelle instinctively realized that these stacks of paper were not mere administrative documents. In her eyes, they read like blueprints for vast capital that crossed borders. (남자 직원들이 “머리 아프다”며 내팽개친 서류를 꼼꼼히 채워 넣는 것이 그녀의 일상이었다. 하지만 미셸은 그 종이 뭉치들이 단순한 행정 서류가 아님을 본능적으로 깨달았다. 미셸 눈엔 국경을 넘나드는 거대한 자본의 설계도로 읽혔다.)

Whenever she drew the complex logistics routes in her mind and found loopholes in the documents, Michelle unconsciously bit down hard on her lower lip, almost crushing it. (미셸은 복잡한 물류 경로를 머릿속으로 그리며 서류의 허점을 찾아낼 때마다, 자신도 모르게 아랫입술을 짓이기듯 깨물었다.)

The opportunity came in 2007. The Saffron Revolution erupted in Myanmar. When the military junta violently suppressed the monk-led democracy protests, the US immediately imposed financial sanctions and asset freezes on the Myanmar military. The media called it the "weaponization of the dollar." (기회가 찾아온 것은 2007년이었다. 미얀마에서 사프란 혁명이 터졌다. 승려들이 주도한 민주화 시위를 군정이 무력으로 진압하자, 미국은 즉각 미얀마 군부에 대한 금융 제재와 자산 동결 조치를 시행했다. 언론에선 이를 ‘달러의 무기화’라고 불렀다.)

With the dollar payment network blocked, the Chinese government's arms export route, which had been pro-Myanmar, was also blocked. Commissions for finding ships to carry Chinese-made ammunition and weapons parts skyrocketed to four times the usual rate. But no trading company in Hong Kong dared touch this honey pot. Because the moment you landed on the US sanctions list, it meant a death sentence in the global financial system. (달러 결제망이 막히면서 친(親)미얀마 노선이었던 중국 정부의 무기 수출 길도 함께 막혔다. 중국산 탄약과 무기 부품을 실어나를 배를 찾는 커미션은 평소의 4배까지 치솟았다. 그러나 홍콩의 어떤 무역 회사도 이 꿀단지를 건드리지 못했다. 미국의 제재 명단에 오르는 순간, 그것은 글로벌 금융 시스템에서의 사형 선고를 의미했기 때문이다.)

To make matters worse, the global financial crisis erupted. As the company wavered between the fear of bankruptcy and enormous profits, Michelle, sitting at her desk in the corner of the office, stood before the boss with a stack of documents. (엎친데 덮친 격으로 글로벌 금융위기까지 터졌다. 회사가 도산의 공포와 막대한 수익 사이에서 갈팡질팡할 때, 사무실 구석 데스크에 앉아 있던 미셸은 서류 뭉치를 들고 사장 앞에 섰다.)

She saw this situation as an opportunity instead. (이런 상황을 오히려 기회로 본 것이었다.)

"I will open a path." (“제가 길을 뚫겠습니다.”)

Her eyes, full of ambition, were quite audacious. (욕망이 가득한 눈초리가 제법 당돌했다.)

"Sending it directly from Hong Kong to Yangon is a 100% guaranteed interception. I've set up a shell company in Cambodia to launder the end user as an agricultural machinery importer, and planned a route that bypasses the Thai land route. For payment, if we mix the renminbi and gold bullion instead of dollars, we can evade the US surveillance network." (“홍콩에서 양곤으로 바로 보내면 100% 걸립니다. 캄보디아에 페이퍼 컴퍼니를 세워 최종 사용자를 농기계 수입상으로 세탁하고, 태국 육로를 우회하는 경로를 짰습니다. 결제는 달러 대신 위안화와 금 현물을 섞으면 미국 감시망을 피할 수 있습니다.”)

The boss nodded dismissively, saying "Handle it as you please," and hid in his office fiddling with his old Nokia phone. After all, the company was going to go bankrupt next month anyway. (사장은 귀찮다는 듯 고개를 끄덕이고는 알아서 하라는 말만 남긴 채 구형 노키아 핸드폰을 매만지며 사장실로 숨었다. 어차피 다음 달이면 파산할 회사였기에.)

Michelle returned to her seat and silently repeated the paperwork. She had never studied trade. She had only spent every night probing the loopholes in customs documents and designing her own ghost routes. (미셸은 자리로 돌아가 묵묵히 서류 작업을 반복했다. 무역학을 공부한 적은 없었다. 매일 밤 세관 서류의 허점을 파고들며 자신만의 유령 경로를 설계해 왔을 뿐이었다.)

The poisoned chalice that no one wanted to take responsibility for, Michelle voluntarily drank it down. (아무도 책임지려 하지 않았던 독배를, 미셸은 자진해서 들이켰다.)

And while US reconnaissance satellites watched the sea, the Chinese-made weapons, transformed into agricultural machinery parts at the tip of Michelle's pen, penetrated the jungle dust and reached their destination. (그리고 미국의 정찰 위성이 바다를 지켜보는 동안, 중국산 무기들은 미셸의 펜 끝에서 농기계 부품으로 둔갑해 정글의 흙먼지를 뚫고 목적지에 도달했다.)

The night Yangon arrival was confirmed, a tropical downpour poured over Tsim Sha Tsui. (양곤 도착이 확인된 날 밤, 침사추이엔 열대성 폭우가 쏟아졌다.)

The light of the neon signs flowed down the rain-soaked windows like oil paint. (네온사인의 불빛이 빗물에 젖은 창문 위로 유채물감처럼 흘러내렸다.)

Only Michelle remained in the office after everyone had left, buried under stacks of documents under the yellow fluorescent light. (모두가 퇴근한 사무실에 미셸만이 남았다. 노란 형광등 아래, 서류 뭉치에 파묻힌 채.)

Just as Michelle was about to turn off the office lights, a man, reeking of the sharp smell of rainwater, kicked open the office door without warning. (미셸이 사무실 불을 끄려 할 때, 한 사내가 비릿한 빗물 냄새를 풍기며 예고 없이 사무실 문을 박차고 들어왔다.)

Without even shaking the rain from his trench coat shoulders, he strode straight toward Michelle, then changed direction and roughly swept through the statements piled on the desk. (비에 젖은 트렌치코트 어깨를 털지도 않은 채 곧장 미셸을 향해 성큼성큼 걸어오더니, 이내 방향을 바꿔 책상 위에 쌓인 명세서를 거칠게 훑었다.)

"The Myanmar project, cargo 0304-MN. On paper, it was an agricultural machinery engine bound for Bangkok, but the goods arrived precisely at a military base on the outskirts of Yangon." (“미얀마 프로젝트, 0304-MN 화물. 서류상으론 방콕행 농기계 엔진이었는데, 물건은 양곤 외곽 군부 기지에 정확히 도착했더군.”)

"So, is there a typo in the LOI?" she guessed he was a client coming to make a complaint. (“그래서, LOI에 오타라도 있나요?” 무언가 컴플레인을 하려 온 클라이언트라 짐작했다.)

"Wei Chen cash laundering to evade US financial sanctions. Perfect." (“미국의 금융 제재를 피해 위안화 현찰 세탁까지. 완벽해.”)

"Who exactly are you?" (“도대체 누구시죠?”)

Michelle replied, turning the office lights back on. (미셸은 사무실 불을 다시 켜면서 대꾸했다.)

The man casually hung his wet coat on the edge of her desk and continued speaking without introducing himself. (남자는 젖은 코트를 책상에 적당히 걸쳐 두곤, 제 소개는 생략한 채 말을 이어갔다.)

"When the veterans in this business were all waving their hands and running away, I was curious who designed this crazy route. I was told it was a low-level female employee stuck in this back-alley office, so I came looking." (“이 바닥 베테랑들이 다들 손사래 치며 도망칠 때, 누가 이 미친 경로를 설계했는지 궁금했거든. 그게 이런 후미진 사무실에 쳐 박혀 있는 말단 여직원이라는 걸 소개받고 찾아온 거야.”)

Only then did Michelle look him straight in the face. (미셸이 비로소 그를 정면으로 응시했다.)

A pallid face with no makeup. Upon closer inspection, a strange charm capable of captivating anyone at a glance lurked behind the shadowed complexion, and the man caught it in an instant. (화장기 하나 없는 창백한 얼굴이었다. 자세히 보면 사람을 단번에 홀릴 만한 기묘한 매혹이 그늘진 안색 뒤에 숨어 있는 걸 이 남자는 한 눈에 낚아챘다.)

Especially the small mole embedded just below her right eye, which, contrasting with her cool gaze, gave off a peculiarly dangerous aura. (특히 오른쪽 눈 밑에 박힌 작은 점은, 서늘한 그녀의 눈빛과 대비되어 묘하게 위험한 분위기를 풍겼다.)

The man leaned against the edge of Michelle's desk and asked in a low voice. (남자는 미셸의 책상 모서리를 짚으며 낮은 목소리로 물었다.)

"What made you take on such a task?" (“뭘 위해 이런 일을 자처한 거지?”)

"Fortune in risk lies." Wealth is found amidst danger. (“부귀험중구(富貴險中求).” 부귀는 위험 속에서 구하는 법.)

Michelle mumbled in a low voice, releasing her crushed lower lip. (미셸이 짓이겨진 아랫입술을 떼며 낮은 목소리로 읊조렸다.)

At that, Li Dawei gave a strange smile, pulled out a red Chinese cigarette from his pocket, and lit it. (그러자 리다웨이는 기묘한 미소를 지으며 품 안에서 붉은색 중화 담배를 꺼내 물었다.)

"Also in risk dies." It is also lost amidst danger. (“야재험중구(也在險中丟).” 또한 위험 속에서 잃기도 하는 법.)

Michelle stared at him, gradually opening up her inner thoughts. (미셸은 그를 물끄러미 바라보며 조금씩 속내를 터놨다.)

"Hong Kong customs obsess over the numbers in documents, and the US only fixates on the flow of dollars. But goods are ultimately moved by people. Set up a ghost company in Cambodia to change the owner, and send trucks along the muddy roads of northern Thailand—they'll never catch it." (“홍콩 세관은 서류의 숫자에 집착하고, 미국은 달러의 흐름에만 집착해요. 하지만 물건은 결국 사람이 옮기는 거죠. 캄보디아에 유령 회사를 세워 주인을 바꾸고, 태국 북부의 진흙길을 따라 트럭을 보내면 그들은 절대 못 잡아요.”)

"A route not found in textbooks." (“교과서엔 없는 경로군.”)

"Because knowing the customs officers' lunch break is more important than textbook theories." (“교과서 이론 따위보다 세관원들의 점심시간을 아는 게 더 중요하니까.”)

A deep smile hung on the man's lips. (남자의 입고리에 짙은 미소가 걸렸다.)

"A shipping company operator without a college degree sees a US financial blockade not as a death sentence, but as a money-making opportunity. Your boss has probably bought an apartment on Hong Kong Island thanks to you." (“대학 졸업장도 없는 해운회사 오퍼레이터가 미국의 금융 봉쇄를 사형 선고가 아닌 돈 벌 기회로 봤다니. 자네 사장은 지금 자네 덕분에 홍콩섬에 아파트 한 채는 거뜬히 샀겠군.”)

"I just find it more enjoyable to see the routes I design actually working." (“나는 내가 설계한 경로가 실제로 작동하는 걸 보는 게 더 즐거울 뿐이에요.”)

"You don't strike me as the type to work just for enjoyment." (“즐거움만으로 일할 것 같은 인상은 아닌데.”)

The man's sneering retort and the acrid cigarette smoke dissipated into the humid air. (빈정거리는 남자의 대꾸와 매캐한 담배 연기가 습한 공기 중에 흩어졌다.)

"I'd like to entrust you with a few more jobs. What do you think?" (“몇 가지 일을 더 맡기고 싶은데, 어떻게 생각하나.”)

"What kind of work?" (“무슨 일이요?”)

Michelle looked at the man. Her eyes were not uncomprehending. She had already read from his first sentence that this man was no mere intermediary. (미셸은 남자를 쳐다봤다. 영문을 모르는 눈은 아니었다. 이 사내가 단순한 중개인이 아니라는 것쯤은 첫 문장에서 이미 읽었다.)

But she also knew she was not in a position to refuse. (다만 거절할 수 있는 위치가 아니라는 것도 알았다.)

"When you contact me from now on, use the name Lily." (“앞으로 나와 연락할 땐 릴리라는 이름을 쓰도록 하지.”)

He seemed to have no intention of revealing his identity to the end. (그는 끝까지 이 자리에서 제 정체는 말할 생각은 없어보였다.)

Then, he placed a silver Zippo lighter engraved with a lily pattern on her desk. (그리곤, 그녀의 책상 위에 백합 문양이 새겨진 은색 지포 라이터를 내려놓았다.)

"Elegant but with deadly poison, a lily. Just like you." (“우아하지만 치명적인 독을 품은 백합. 딱 당신 같군.”)

Michelle stared silently at the lighter, then nodded lightly. It was an unofficial signing ceremony where a nameless female employee of Tsim Sha Tsui was reborn as an agent of immense political power. (미셸은 라이터를 가만히 쳐다보다가 가볍게 고개를 끄덕였다. 침사추이의 이름 없는 여직원이 거대 정치 권력의 대리인으로 거듭나는 비공식적인 조인식이었다.)

And the next target pointed out by the man she met in Hong Kong was Evan. (그리고, 홍콩에서 만난 그 남자가 가리킨 다음 목표는 에반이었다.)

item.title: Korean-American ‘Powerful’ Group Angry at Ambassador to US… “Avoiding the Spotlight Out of Caution, Causing Disappointment and Dismay” (주미 대사에 뿔난 ‘실세’ 한인 단체… “눈치 보며 자리 피해, 실망과 경악”)
item.description:
Korean-American ‘Powerful’ Group Angry at Ambassador to US… “Avoiding the Spotlight Out of Caution, Causing Disappointment and Dismay” (주미 대사에 뿔난 ‘실세’ 한인 단체… “눈치 보며 자리 피해, 실망과 경악”)

Choi Kwang-chul, head of the pro-progressive Korean-American organization Korean American Participation and Action Committee (KAPAC), has taken issue with Ambassador to the US Kang Kyung-wha’s absence from an event, claiming, “The ambassador, who should be at the forefront of peace diplomacy, avoided the spotlight out of caution, leaving attendees unable to hide their disappointment and dismay,” and asking, “What are the security office, the foreign ministry, and the embassy to the US of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which was born with the support of progressive and peace forces, doing?” Choi, a Korean-American businessman, is known to be a junior at Kyung Hee University Law School to former President Moon Jae-in and served as a diplomatic and security special advisor for President Lee Jae-myung’s election campaign, with ties dating back to Lee’s tenure as mayor of Seongnam. He has been active in pushing for the so-called “Korean Peninsula Peace Act” (H.R. 1841), which calls for a declaration to end the Korean War, to pass through the US Congress. <<> The incident began with the “2026 Korean Peninsula Peace Conference” held by KAPAC in Washington DC from the 24th to the 26th of last month. The event was flooded with congratulatory messages from key figures in the ruling camp, including President Lee Jae-myung, former President Moon Jae-in, and National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik. The organizers initially notified the media that Ambassador Kang would also attend, but on the day of the event, Rep. Song Young-gil of the Democratic Party, who led a delegation from South Korea to the US, took the stage to read President Lee’s congratulatory remarks on his behalf. Choi is known to be close to Rep. Song Young-gil, and reportedly attended a meeting when Song visited the US in April to meet with then-Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard. On stage, Song said, “Next year, we’ll ensure that the ministers of foreign affairs and unification can also attend.” Choi recently noted on his social media, “The ambassador, who should have graced the event, ultimately didn’t show up, leading to the regrettable scene of former leader Song Young-gil reading the president’s congratulatory remarks.” <<> The event was attended by about 10 Democratic House members, including Brad Sherman, who proposed the declaration of war end bill, and Korean-American Dave Min. Sherman is a prominent anti-Trump figure in the Democratic Party, who proposed an impeachment motion against Trump during his first term. KAPAC recently announced that 52 lawmakers have signed onto the bill, “securing support from 12% of the 435 members of the US House of Representatives,” but since the majority are Democratic lawmakers and mainstream Republican lawmakers oppose it, the bill’s chances of passing this session are slim. It was also automatically discarded during the 117th and 118th Congresses. Choi criticized the government for participating as a co-sponsor of the UN resolution on North Korean human rights and mentioning North Korean denuclearization in a joint statement with the European Union, claiming, “Outwardly, they say they will become the ‘pacemaker for Trump, the peacemaker,’ but their actual actions are mired in the contradiction of following the same hardline confrontation structure of the previous Yoon Suk Yeol administration.” <<> Last month, Choi also stated on his social media, “The most disappointing aspect of the Lee Jae-myung administration is its absolute lack of understanding of new public diplomacy, which aims to achieve peace on the Korean Peninsula by expanding the actors of diplomacy,” adding, “The traditional subservient diplomacy centered on the security office, which is staffed by former foreign ministry officials, continues. When necessary, decisive action such as reviewing the transfer and decentralization of Korean Peninsula peace diplomacy from the foreign ministry to the unification ministry is needed.” He also argued, “A sweeping personnel overhaul in the diplomatic and security sectors is urgent.” Ambassador Kang unusually returned to South Korea temporarily from the 15th to the 19th of last month under the direction of Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and stayed in the country. During her visit to South Korea, she met with relevant ministries to discuss major pending issues between Korea and the US, leading to various interpretations about the background behind this. (미국의 친여(親與) 성향 한인 단체인 미주민주참여포럼(KAPAC)의 최광철 대표가 행사에 강경화 주미대사가 참석하지 않은 것을 문제 삼으며 “평화 외교의 최전선에 서야 할 주미대사가 눈치를 보며 자리를 피한 사태에 참석자들이 실망과 경악을 금치 못했다” “진보·평화 세력의 지지로 탄생한 이재명 정부의 안보실, 외교부, 주미대사관은 무얼 하고 있는가”라고 주장했다. 재미(在美) 사업가인 최 대표는 문재인 전 대통령의 경희대 법대 후배이자 이재명 대통령의 대선 캠프 외교·안보 특보 출신으로 성남시장 시절부터 인연을 맺은 것으로 알려져 있다. 한반도 종전 선언 등을 골자로 하는 이른바 ‘한반도 평화 법안(H.R. 1841)’의 미 의회 통과를 위한 활동을 해왔다.)

item.title: Lee Decides Not to Collect Interest on Mortgage… Blue House Says “Gift Tax Will Be Handled According to Regulations” (李, 근저당 이자 안 받기로… 靑 “증여세는 규정대로 처리”)
item.description:
Lee Decides Not to Collect Interest on Mortgage… Blue House Says “Gift Tax Will Be Handled According to Regulations” (李, 근저당 이자 안 받기로… 靑 “증여세는 규정대로 처리”)

The Blue House announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung, in the process of selling an apartment he owned in Bundang, Gyeonggi Province, decided not to collect interest from the buyer on the 1.77 billion won mortgage set on the property. The mortgage was established because the buyer lacked funds to pay the balance, deferring payment until October. This essentially means the president will not collect interest on the money lent, which is akin to an interest-free loan. <<> Vice Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong of the Blue House appeared on the Blue House’s YouTube channel “Fact Mill” that day alongside Professor Han Moon-do of Seoul Digital University’s Department of Real Estate to address suspicions regarding President Lee’s home sale. Vice Spokesperson Ahn stated, “When the balance payment is deferred for several months, given the large amount, the interest could be substantial, but it has been confirmed that the decision was made not to collect the interest.” Professor Han remarked, “It appears the president considered the buyer’s circumstances. While questions may arise about why no interest was charged, the interest was waived considering the mere three-to-four-month difference.” <<> However, concerns have been raised that failing to collect interest could pose issues, as it effectively constitutes a gift. Under current tax law, borrowing money from another person for free or at an interest rate lower than the appropriate market rate results in the difference being considered a ‘gift.’ Earlier this May, the National Tax Service announced plans for tax audits on suspected real estate tax evaders, citing cases where individuals borrowed large sums from parents or related parties to acquire homes due to loan restrictions making bank loans difficult. <<> In response, the Blue House stated, “The issue of gift tax arising from the interest-free loan will be handled according to relevant regulations.” This indicates the buyer will be responsible for paying the gift tax. Criticism from the People Power Party, which claimed that even interest-free loans between parents and children are viewed as “abnormal transactions” subject to tax audits, seems to have prompted the Blue House to clarify its stance again. The Blue House also issued a written statement the previous day, saying, “The transaction was a standard real estate deal conducted through a licensed realtor, and the mortgage was merely security for the unpaid balance. It is not true that there is a special relationship with the buyer.” <<> Meanwhile, President Lee will hold a 100-minute national town hall meeting on real estate policy starting at 10 a.m. on the 23rd. The government plans to hear opinions from about 140 participants, including experts, construction and financial industry officials, journalists, YouTubers, licensed realtors, and actual homebuyers, to inform real estate policy. Whether the president will address the sale of the Bundang apartment is also a point of interest. (이재명 대통령이 경기 분당에 보유했던 아파트 매도 과정에서 17억7000여만원의 근저당권을 설정한 것과 관련해 매수인에게 이에 대한 이자를 받지 않기로 했다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다. 매수인이 돈이 부족해 잔금 납부를 10월까지 유예하는 대신 근저당권을 설정한 것인데, 사실상 빌려준 돈에 대한 이자를 받지 않겠다는 뜻이다.)

item.title: PPP Young Turks Propose Abolishing Party Leader, Citing "Imperial System Side Effects" (당대표 폐지론 꺼낸 국힘 소장파 “제왕적 체제 부작용 커”)
item.description:
PPP Young Turks Propose Abolishing Party Leader, Citing "Imperial System Side Effects" (당대표 폐지론 꺼낸 국힘 소장파 “제왕적 체제 부작용 커”)

Within the People Power Party (PPP), arguments are being raised in succession to abolish the party leader system or drastically reduce its powers. The claim is that the operational structure concentrating power in the party leader needs innovation. As non-mainstream members calling for representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation have begun open discussions, talk has also emerged from parts of the former pro-Yoon faction saying, "There's no suitable figure to lead an election victory, so the system must be changed." (국민의힘에서 당대표제를 폐지하거나 권한을 대폭 축소하자는 주장이 잇따라 제기되고 있다. 당대표에게 권한이 집중돼 있는 운영 구조를 혁신하자는 주장이다. 장동혁 대표 퇴진을 요구해온 비주류가 공개적으로 논의를 시작한 가운데, 옛 친윤계 일각에서도 “총선 승리를 이끌 인물이 마땅치 않으니 제도를 바꿔야 한다”는 이야기가 나온다.)

On the 22nd, 'Alternatives and Future', a gathering primarily of PPP first and second-term lawmakers, held a breakfast meeting at the National Assembly to discuss ways to improve the "imperial party leader system." Lawmaker Choi Hyung-du, serving as the presenter, explained that the current party leader system concentrates authority, including the power of candidate nomination, on the leader, causing excessive factional conflict. Lee Seong-kwon, the meeting's secretary, stated, "It's true that concentrating authority over party operations, personnel, and nominations on the party leader has many side effects. There were also critical views raised (at the meeting) regarding the party membership structure composed of some hardline supporters." <<> Previously within the PPP, lawmakers like Choi Hyung-du had argued for adopting a U.S.-style party system centered on the floor leader, but this failed to gain traction. However, following the June local elections, calls for abolishing the party leader system intensified both inside and outside the party. At a seminar on July 24th for the 'Future Innovation Forum', a lawmaker research group led by the former pro-Yoon faction, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon questioned, "Is a party leader truly necessary?" adding, "The party leader's involvement in every social phenomenon has normalized political strife." On the 21st, five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun, after meeting with Mayor Oh, mentioned abolishing the party leader system and introducing a national primary system. <<> PPP lawmakers say the attention on abolishing the party leader system is not unrelated to dissatisfaction with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's party management. Right after the local elections, 'Alternatives and Future', the pro-Han faction, and some senior lawmakers publicly demanded Jang's resignation, but Jang did not accept. A pro-Han lawmaker commented, "Representative Jang has proven that once someone becomes party leader, they can hold on no matter how much resignation pressure erupts. The sentiment that the system itself must change has grown." <<> Such concerns are also detectable within the former pro-Yoon faction that supported Representative Jang at last year's national convention. A former pro-Yoon lawmaker explained, "There's a consensus that winning the 2028 general election is difficult under Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership, but there's no suitable card to immediately replace him. So, proposals are emerging from the perspective of 'how about changing the system instead of finding a person.' There's also much deliberation among lawmakers over various alternatives." Within this group, some argue the system should be revised not only regarding Jang but also to prepare for a scenario where independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon rejoins the party and takes the leadership. <<> If abolishing the party leader system is difficult, there are also opinions that a collective leadership system should be introduced to limit the party leader's authority. Six-term lawmaker Joo Ho-young said in a media interview last month, "Isn't it time for a collective leadership system?" A party official stated, "To win the general election, it's necessary to have both the former pro-Yoon and pro-Han factions compete within a collective leadership system." Lawmaker Choi Hyung-du suggested, "One option is to establish a permanent decision-making body where chairpersons of all provincial and city party branches participate ex-officio, involving the party leader as well, to better reflect public sentiment." <<> However, among mainstream lawmakers from the Yeongnam region, there is a sense that further discussion is needed on abolishing the party leader system or transitioning to a collective leadership. A senior lawmaker noted, "There is consensus that we need to revise the rules for electing the party leader, which strongly reflect the voices of hardline party members, before the next national convention to win the general election. But the momentum to enact a change as drastic as abolishing the party leader system is still lacking." <<> The pro-leadership faction tends to dismiss the possibility of abolishing the party leader system, evaluating the calls for abolition as an attempt to bring down Representative Jang. Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won said on YTN Radio today regarding the abolition theory, "It was already argued during the Park Geun-hye emergency committee in 2012, but it wasn't accepted for various reasons. It's impossible without completely abolishing the central party nomination system and switching to a national primary. It has no feasibility." There are also opinions that the positive functions of the party leader system cannot be ignored. An non-lawmaker figure stated, "If the party becomes too focused on the legislature, it could degenerate into an organization that solely represents incumbent lawmakers' interests." (국민의힘 초·재선 의원 중심 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’는 22일 국회에서 조찬 모임을 열고 ‘제왕적 당대표 체제’ 개선 방안을 논의했다. 최형두 의원이 발제자로 나서 현행 당대표제는 대표에게 공천권 등 권한이 집중돼 과도한 계파 갈등을 유발한다고 설명했다. 모임 간사인 이성권 의원은 “당 운영과 인사 및 공천에 관한 권한이 당대표에게 집중되면서 부작용이 많은 것이 사실”이라며 “일부 강성 지지층으로 구성된 당원 구조에 대한 문제 의식도 (모임에서) 나왔다”고 했다.)

item.title: Opposition Faces Risk of Losing Major Presidential Candidate… "Ruling Party Innocent, Opposition Guilty, a Political Verdict" (野, 유력 대선주자 잃을 위기… “여당무죄 야당유죄, 정치 판결”)
item.description:
Opposition Faces Risk of Losing Major Presidential Candidate… "Ruling Party Innocent, Opposition Guilty, a Political Verdict" (野, 유력 대선주자 잃을 위기… “여당무죄 야당유죄, 정치 판결”)

As Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, considered a leading candidate for the next presidential election, received a sentence of a 10 million won fine—a ruling that would result in the loss of his mayoral position—in the first trial of the "political broker" Myung Tae-kyun's poll manipulation scandal on the 22nd, the People Power Party expressed a sense of dismay while stating, "It’s a judge's prejudice relying on Myung Tae-kyun's testimony" (according to Chief Whip Jung Jeom-sik). Mayor Oh, who secured reelection in the June local elections, has recently been openly criticizing the real estate policies of President Lee Jae-myung’s administration. Although appeals and a Supreme Court ruling are still pending, there are forecasts that Mayor Oh’s political activities will inevitably face constraints until the Supreme Court's expected decision around January next year. Although Mayor Oh indicated his intention to appeal immediately, the ruling party effectively called for his resignation, launching an offensive. (차기 대권 주자로 꼽히는 오세훈 서울시장이 22일 ‘정치 브로커’ 명태균씨 여론조사 의혹 사건 1심에서 시장직 상실형에 해당하는 벌금 1000만원 선고를 받자 국민의힘은 “명태균의 진술에 의존한 판사의 예단”(정점식 원내대표)이라면서도 당혹스러워하는 분위기다. 오 시장은 6월 지방선거에서 연임에 성공한 이후 최근 이재명 정부의 부동산 정책을 정면 비판해왔다. 2심과 대법원 판결이 남았지만 내년 1월 전후로 예상되는 대법원 판결 전까지 오 시장의 정치 행보가 위축될 수밖에 없을 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 오 시장은 이날 바로 항소하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔지만 여당은 사실상 사퇴를 요구하며 공세를 폈다.)

Mayor Oh emerged as a leading opposition presidential candidate after the June 3 local elections. In an election deemed disadvantageous for conservatives following the martial law and presidential impeachment, he defeated the Democratic Party’s "Myung-pick" (President Lee Jae-myung’s chosen candidate). Recently, he gained attention by raising issues with real estate policies during a Cabinet meeting chaired by President Lee Jae-myung and by criticizing the government’s real estate policies in a YouTube lecture. A political insider commented, "The atmosphere was one of confidence in his innocence, but with a guilty verdict in the first trial, it will likely be difficult for him to maintain an adversarial stance with the government for the time being. His activities in Seoul city administration will inevitably be significantly constrained as well." (오 시장은 6·3 지방선거 이후 야권의 차기 대권 주자로 부상했다. 계엄과 대통령 탄핵 이후 보수에 불리하다고 평가받은 선거에서, 민주당 ‘명픽’(이재명 대통령의 선택) 후보에게 승리했다. 최근에는 이재명 대통령 주재 국무회의에 참석해 부동산 정책에 대해 문제 제기하고, 유튜브 강의를 통해 정부의 부동산 정책을 비판하며 주목받았다. 정치권 관계자는 “무죄를 확신하던 분위기였는데 1심에서 유죄가 나오면서 당분간 정부와 각을 세우는 건 어렵지 않겠느냐”며 “서울 시정에서도 활동이 크게 위축될 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

There are also predictions that Mayor Oh’s push for change within the People Power Party will be impacted. During the local election period, Mayor Oh expressed a critical stance toward the line taken by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who focuses on the hardline support base. While around 20 lawmakers were known to have directly supported Mayor Oh’s campaign during the last election, many People Power Party lawmakers—including those from the former pro-Yoon faction—had expanded their contacts with Mayor Oh following his electoral victory. An opposition insider noted, "Although it’s not a final ruling, with Mayor Oh now carrying a judicial risk, lawmakers’ calculations will become more complicated." (국민의힘 내에선 당의 변화를 촉구해온 오 시장의 행보도 영향을 받을 것이라는 전망도 나온다. 오 시장은 지방선거 기간 강성 지지층 중심인 장동혁 대표 노선에 비판적인 입장을 밝혔다. 지난 선거 당시 오 시장 캠프를 직접 도운 의원은 20여 명으로 알려졌지만 선거 승리 이후에는 옛 친윤계를 비롯해 상당수 국민의힘 의원들이 오 시장과의 접촉을 확대해왔다. 야권 관계자는 “아직 최종 판결은 아니지만 오 시장이 사법 리스크를 안게 되면서 의원들의 계산도 복잡해질 것”이라고 했다.)

Following the ruling on this day, the People Power Party leadership issued a series of critical statements. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk said, "President Lee Jae-myung’s regime’s suppression of the opposition and political oppression have no end," adding, "We trust the judgment of the higher court, and Seoul city administration must continue without interruption." Chief Whip Jung Jeom-sik also stated, "It is questionable whether a guilty verdict can be reached solely based on a judge’s prejudice relying entirely on Myung Tae-kyun’s testimony. We hope for more thorough verification and judgment in the appellate trial." (이날 판결이 나오자 국민의힘 지도부는 일제히 비판 성명을 냈다. 장동혁 대표는 “이재명 정권의 야당 죽이기와 정치 탄압, 끝이 없다”며 “상급심의 판단을 믿고 서울시정은 중단 없이 계속되어야 한다”고 했다. 정점식 원내대표도 “전적으로 명태균의 진술에 의존한 판사의 예단만으로 유죄 판결을 내릴 수 있는지 의문”이라며 “항소심에서 보다 면밀한 검증과 판단이 이뤄지길 기대한다”고 했다.)

Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the People Power Party, declared, "The ruling party is innocent, the opposition is guilty," and "We strongly denounce this political verdict that destroys judicial justice." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon wrote on Facebook, "Today’s guilty verdict in the first trial is hard to accept due to the low reliability of the involved witness's testimony and numerous leaps in logic. I hope it will be corrected in the appellate trial." (박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 “여당 무죄·야당 유죄”라며 “사법 정의를 무너뜨린 정치 판결을 강력히 규탄한다”고 했다. 무소속 한동훈 의원은 페이스북에 “오늘 1심 유죄 판결은 관련자 증언의 신빙성이 떨어지고 비약이 많아 납득하기 어렵다”며 “항소심에서 바로잡히기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, said, "We hope [Mayor Oh] will humbly accept his guilt and fulfill his legal and political responsibilities." Choi Jeong-eun, spokesperson for the Democratic Party at the Seoul Metropolitan Council, effectively called for Mayor Oh’s resignation from the mayoral post, stating, "We ask for a bold decision to minimize the burden on city administration and return to normal politics." (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 “죄를 겸허히 인정하고 법적, 정치적 책임을 다하기를 바란다”고 했다. 서울시의회 최정은 민주당 대변인은 “시정 부담을 최소화하고 정상 정치로의 회귀를 위해 용단을 내리라”며 사실상 시장직 사퇴를 요구했다.)

item.title: Slow-Moving U.S.-Korea Nuclear Agreement Revision… Saudi Arabia Could Set a Precedent (속도 못내는 한미 원자력 협정 개정… 사우디가 선례 될 수도)
item.description:
Slow-Moving U.S.-Korea Nuclear Agreement Revision… Saudi Arabia Could Set a Precedent (속도 못내는 한미 원자력 협정 개정… 사우디가 선례 될 수도)

The South Korean government is closely watching the new nuclear cooperation agreement (123 Agreement) signed between the United States and Saudi Arabia, which opens the door to Saudi Arabia's potential uranium enrichment, and how it might impact negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. to secure Seoul's rights to uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing. During a briefing on the 22nd, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said of the U.S.-Saudi agreement, "We have also been watching it with interest," adding, "It doesn't have direct implications for us, but it does have indirect ones." A foreign ministry official commented, "We can consider what considerations led the U.S. to make this decision and whether there is anything in this process that could benefit us." (우리 정부는 미국과 사우디아라비아 간에 사우디의 잠재적 우라늄 농축 가능성을 열어주는 새로운 원자력 협력 협정(123협정)이 체결된 것이 한국의 우라늄 농축, 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보를 위한 한미 간 협상에 어떤 영향을 끼칠지 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 22일 브리핑에서 미국과 사우디 간 협정에 대해 “저희도 관심을 갖고 봐왔다”며 “우리에게 직접 함의가 있진 않지만, 간접 함의가 있기 때문”이라고 말했다. 외교부 당국자는 “미국이 어떤 고려를 하고 이런 결정을 했는지, 이 과정에서 우리에게 도움이 되는 것이 있는지 등을 생각해 볼 수 있지 않겠나”라고 말했다.)

In a joint fact sheet adopted following last year's South Korea-U.S. summit, the two countries agreed that "the United States supports procedures that will result in South Korea's civilian uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing." This was interpreted as potentially opening the way for Seoul to secure substantive rights by revising the current nuclear cooperation agreement, which effectively bans South Korea's enrichment and reprocessing activities. However, follow-up discussions on this matter had not been held for over six months until the first meeting finally took place in Seoul early last month. The schedule for a second meeting has yet to be confirmed. (한미 양국은 지난해 한미 정상회담 결과 채택한 조인트 팩트시트(공동 설명 자료)에서 ‘미국은 한국의 민간 우라늄 농축 및 사용후핵연료 재처리로 귀결될 절차를 지지한다’고 합의했다. 한국의 농축·재처리를 사실상 금지한 현행 원자력 협력 협정을 개정해 실질적 권한 확보의 길을 열어줄 수도 있다는 취지로 풀이됐다. 다만 이를 위한 후속 협의는 6개월 이상 열리지 않다가, 지난달 초에야 서울에서 만나 첫 회의를 했다. 아직 2차 회의 일정은 확정되지 않은 상태다.)

Director Wi stated that day, "One of the security discussions between South Korea and the U.S. involves enrichment and reprocessing, and there are no obstacles," adding, "We are preparing for the second discussion, and if necessary, we are ready to go to the U.S. for it." A foreign ministry official also said, "We are in dialogue with the U.S. side based on a shared understanding to proceed as quickly as possible." (위 실장은 이날 “한미 안보 협의 중 하나가 농축·재처리인데, 무슨 장애는 없다”며 “두 번째 협의를 준비하고 있고 필요하면 우리가 (미국에) 가서 할 태세를 갖추고 있다”고 말했다. 외교부 당국자도 “최대한 빨리 진행해 나가자는 공감대를 갖고 미국 측과 대화하고 있다”고 말했다.)

In diplomatic circles, analysis suggests that if the agreement with Saudi Arabia takes effect without significant opposition from the U.S. Congress, it could serve as a "good precedent" for South Korea. This is because the U.S. administration would find it harder to refuse South Korea's demands using the excuse of "high congressional hurdles," and if a new agreement is reached between South Korea and the U.S., it would likely pass the congressional review process smoothly. Another advantage for South Korea is that while Saudi Arabia refuses to join the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Additional Protocol, which allows for unannounced inspections of undeclared nuclear facilities, South Korea already ratified and implemented the Additional Protocol in 2004, making concerns about nuclear weapons development far less significant. (외교가에서는 사우디와의 협정이 미국 의회의 큰 반대 없이 발효될 경우, 한국 입장에서 ‘좋은 선례’가 될 수도 있다는 분석이 나온다. 미 행정부가 ‘의회의 문턱이 높다’는 핑계로 한국의 요구를 거절하기 어려워지고, 한·미 간에 새 협정이 체결됐을 때 의회 검토 과정을 순조롭게 통과할 가능성이 높아진다는 것이다. 사우디가 미신고 핵 시설에 대한 불시 사찰을 허용하는 국제원자력기구(IAEA) 추가의정서 가입을 거부하고 있는 반면, 한국은 이미 2004년 추가의정서를 비준·발효해 핵무기 개발 우려가 훨씬 적다는 점도 강점이다.)

However, counterarguments suggest that this case cannot be equated with South Korea's situation, given that the Trump administration's choice to cooperate with Saudi Arabia was also driven by economic reasons—such as helping U.S. nuclear power companies like Westinghouse, which have reactor design technology, enter the Saudi market. The Trump administration included a condition that U.S. companies would build uranium enrichment facilities in Saudi Arabia and that the U.S. would manage the core technology, in exchange for accepting Saudi Arabia's demand for "nuclear fuel self-sufficiency," which requires that nuclear fuel be produced domestically. In contrast, South Korea, which possesses world-class nuclear power plant construction technology, is also a competitor from the U.S. perspective. (그러나 트럼프 행정부가 사우디와의 협력을 택한 배경에는 원자로 설계 기술을 가진 웨스팅하우스 등 미국 원전업체의 사우디 진출을 돕겠다는 경제적 이유도 있는 만큼, 한국과 같은 경우로 볼 수 없다는 반론도 제기된다. 트럼프 행정부는 원전 연료가 사우디 내에서 생산돼야 한다는 ‘핵연료 자립’ 요구를 수용하는 조건으로 미국 기업이 사우디에 우라늄 농축 시설을 건설하고 그 핵심 기술도 미국이 관리한다는 단서를 붙였다. 반면, 세계적 원전 건설 기술을 가진 한국은 미국 입장에서 경쟁 상대이기도 하다.)

In this regard, a foreign ministry official said, "With the details of the U.S.-Saudi agreement not yet disclosed, verifying the facts is the priority." This suggests that before hastily assessing pros and cons, Seoul must confirm the specifics of the U.S.-Saudi agreement to prepare for South Korea-U.S. negotiations. (이와 관련해 외교부 관계자는 “미국과 사우디 간 협정 내용이 공개되지 않은 상태에서 사실 관계 파악이 우선”이라고 말했다. 섣불리 유불리를 따지기 전에 미국과 사우디 간 협정의 세부 사항을 확인해 한미 협상을 준비해야 한다는 것이다.)

item.title: Ruling Party to Process Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigative Powers as Early as Next Week (與, 보완수사권 폐지법 이르면 내주 처리)
item.description:
Ruling Party to Process Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigative Powers as Early as Next Week (與, 보완수사권 폐지법 이르면 내주 처리)

The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers before its August 17 national convention. Despite opinions from legal circles, women's groups, and some party lawmakers—triggered by the "Jang Yun-gi case"—calling for the retention of these powers, the leadership has firmly set a course for "complete abolition." The Democratic Party plans to quickly review and pass the bill through the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the National Assembly, and then process the revised Criminal Procedure Act—which includes the abolition of supplementary investigative powers—at a plenary session as early as next week. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 전에 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하기로 방침을 정했다. ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 법조계는 물론 여성단체, 당내 일부 의원들도 보완수사권 존치 의견을 냈지만 지도부가 ‘전면 폐지’를 못 박은 것이다. 민주당은 빠르게 국회 법제사법위원회 심사 및 의결을 거친 뒤 이르면 다음 주 국회 본회의에서 보완수사권 폐지를 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 처리할 계획이다.)

Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do stated at a Supreme Council meeting on the 22nd, "There is no disagreement within the party on the grand principle that prosecutors should not conduct investigations." He added, "We have not forgotten the tragedy of the ruthless investigation that drove former President Roh Moo-hyun to death, and we aim to break the history of unchecked power being abused." He further said, "Reform always faces resistance. Even a small loophole can activate forces trying to return to the past. If we stop or compromise here, only the signboard of the prosecution will change to the Public Prosecution Office, but the essence of prosecutorial power will remain intact." Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon, regarding the timing of the bill's passage, said, "The stance is to process it before the August convention." (한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 22일 최고위원회의에서 “검사는 수사하지 않는다는 대원칙에는 당내 어떠한 이견도 없다”고 말했다. 이어 “노무현 전 대통령을 죽음으로 몰고 간 무도한 수사와 같은 비극을 잊지 않고 통제받지 않는 권력이 남용되는 역사를 끊어내려 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “개혁엔 언제나 저항이 따른다. 작은 빈틈이라도 남겨 과거로 돌아가려는 힘도 작동된다”며 “여기서 멈추거나 타협하면 검찰청 간판만 공소청으로 바뀔 뿐 검찰 권력 본질은 그대로 남게 된다”고 했다. 강준현 수석대변인은 법안 처리 시점과 관련해선 “8월 전당대회 전 처리한다는 기조가 있다”고 했다.)

A key Democratic Party official explained, "We judged that a quick conclusion was necessary amid the issue of supplementary investigative powers affecting the party leadership election." The three candidates for party leadership—former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, lawmaker Song Young-gil, and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae—have all argued for "abolition before the convention," and Jeong reiterated today, "This convention is simple. It's about whether to pursue prosecutorial reform or not." (민주당 핵심 관계자는 “보완수사권 문제가 당대표 선거에 영향을 미치는 상황에서 빠르게 결론을 내려야 한다고 판단했다”고 했다. 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원, 정청래 전 대표 등 당권 주자 3명은 모두 “전당대회 전 폐지”를 주장해왔고, 정 전 대표는 이날도 “이번 전당대회는 간단하다. 검찰 개혁을 하느냐 마느냐의 문제”라고 했다.)

◇ 55% Oppose Abolition of Supplementary Investigative Powers, 27% in Favor (◇보완수사권 폐지 반대 여론 55%, 찬성은 27%)

On the 9th, the Democratic Party proposed a complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers under the name of the "Criminal Procedure Act Revision Task Force." However, after the Jang Yun-gi case in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, revealed police negligence in investigations that prosecutors' supplementary work uncovered, voices calling for retaining these powers grew louder. The Supreme Court, Ministry of Justice, Supreme Prosecutors' Office, as well as lawyer groups, women's organizations, and victims of violent crimes, all expressed concerns over the abolition. Eleven Democratic Party lawmakers also proposed a bill that would allow limited prosecutorial supplementary investigations for crimes like sexual assault and child abuse. Yet, as demands for complete abolition intensified, especially among hardline supporters, the leadership concluded in favor of abolition. (민주당은 지난 9일 ‘형사소송법 개정 TF’ 명의로 보완수사권 전면 폐지안을 발의했다. 그러나 이후 검사 보완수사로 전남광주 장윤기 사건에 대한 경찰의 부실 수사가 드러나면서 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 목소리가 커졌다. 대법원·법무부·대검찰청은 물론 변호사 단체와 여성단체, 강력범죄 피해자들까지 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 우려의 목소리를 냈다. 민주당 의원 11명도 성폭력·아동학대 등 일부 범죄에 대해 검찰 보완수사권을 제한적으로 허용하는 법안을 발의했다. 그러나 강성 지지층을 중심으로 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 요구하는 목소리가 커지자 지도부가 폐지 쪽으로 결론 낸 것이다.)

In response to criticisms that supplementary investigative powers are needed to protect crime victims, Acting Leader Han said today, "Looking back at the dark history of the prosecution, that's not the truth." He stated that measures to protect victims would be developed by strengthening the right to request supplementary investigations, allowing demands for replacement or disciplinary action against officers in charge of negligent investigations, ensuring mutual checks between investigative agencies, and guaranteeing victims' right to object. (한병도 대행은 이날 범죄 피해자 보호를 위해 보완수사권이 필요하다는 지적에 대해선 “검찰의 어두운 과거사를 돌아보면 진실이 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 보완수사요구권 실질화, 부실 수사에 대한 수사관 교체·징계 요구, 수사기관 간 상호 견제, 피해자 이의신청권 보장 등을 통해 범죄 피해자 보호 방안을 마련하겠다고 했다.)

However, concerns over abolishing supplementary investigative powers persist. During a closed-door subcommittee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee today, Democratic Party lawmakers reiterated their stance on abolition, arguing, "If supplementary investigative powers are allowed even in a limited form, we cannot prevent prosecutors from conducting separate investigations." But a Ministry of Justice official reportedly countered, "If prosecutors cannot conduct supplementary investigations, they will inevitably be bound by the conclusions of police investigations." A poll conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 20th and 21st and released today showed that 55.3% of respondents opposed the abolition of supplementary investigative powers, more than double the 27.4% who supported it. <<>> (하지만 보완수사권 폐지를 우려하는 목소리는 이어지고 있다. 이날 법제사법위원회 비공개 법안심사 소위에서 민주당 의원들은 “보완수사권을 제한적으로라도 허용할 경우 검사의 별건 수사를 막을 수 없다”며 폐지 입장을 거듭 밝혔지만, 법무부 관계자는 “검사가 보완수사를 하지 못하게 된다면 경찰의 수사 결론에 귀속될 수밖에 없다”고 주장했다고 한다. 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 20~21일 조사해 이날 발표한 여론조사 결과에선 보완수사권 폐지에 반대하는 의견이 55.3%로 찬성한다(27.4%)는 의견보다 2배 이상 많았다.)

item.title: ROK-U.S.-Japan Meeting in Two Weeks… China’s ICBM, Taiwan Issue Missing from Foreign Ministry Statement (2주 만에 만난 한·미·일… 中 ICBM, 대만 문제 다 빠진 외교부 발표)
item.description:
ROK-U.S.-Japan Meeting in Two Weeks… China’s ICBM, Taiwan Issue Missing from Foreign Ministry Statement (2주 만에 만난 한·미·일… 中 ICBM, 대만 문제 다 빠진 외교부 발표)

The State Department announced that Secretary Marco Rubio met on the 22nd with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and Japanese Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya on the sidelines of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Manila, the Philippines, for a U.S.-South Korea-Japan trilateral foreign ministers' meeting. Spokesperson Tammy Pit said the three foreign ministers "highlighted the importance of trilateral cooperation with ASEAN on mutual interests, including strengthening defense cooperation and maritime security, enhancing energy security, countering cyber threats, and promoting peace and stability in Southeast Asia and the broader Indo-Pacific region." Amid this, a significant temperature difference between the U.S. and South Korea was detected over North Korea and Taiwan issues. (국무부는 마코 루비오 장관이 22일 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안(ASEAN·동남아국가연합) 외교장관 회의를 계기로 조현 외교부 장관, 모테기 도시미쓰(茂木敏充) 일본 외무상과 만나 한·미·일 외교장관 회의를 가졌다고 밝혔다. 토미 피곳 대변인은 이날 3국 외교 장관이 “국방 협력 및 해양 안보 강화, 에너지 안보 증진, 사이버 위협 대응, 동남아시아 및 더 넓은 인도·태평양 지역의 평화와 안정 증진 등 상호 관심사에 대한 아세안과의 협력의 중요성을 강조했다”고 밝혔다. 이런 가운데 북한·대만 문제를 놓고 한미 간 상당한 온도 차가 감지 됐다.)

This meeting took place as maritime disputes between the Philippines and China in the South China Sea intensify by the day. Just before the meeting, on the 20th, Chinese coast guard officers wielded wooden clubs against Philippine troops at Second Thomas Shoal, leading the State Department to "condemn aggressive acts." While the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) ruled in 2016 that China's South China Sea claims lacked legal basis, China has rejected this, drawing its "nine-dash line" corresponding to its own territorial waters concept and claiming sovereignty over most of the sea area. Rubio met with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., emphasizing an "ironclad" alliance and the importance of freedom of navigation and overflight in the South China Sea. He also discussed this issue with foreign ministers of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (QUAD), a multilateral security consultative body. (이번 회의는 남중국해에서 필리핀과 중국의 해상 분쟁이 날이 갈수록 격화되고 있는 가운데 열렸다. 회의 직전인 지난 20일 세컨드 토머스 암초에서 중국 해경이 필리핀군을 상대로 나무 곤봉을 휘두르는 일이 벌어져 국무부가 “공격적 행위를 규탄한다”고 했다. 2016년 국제해양법재판소(ITLOS) 산하 상설중재재판소(PCA)가 중국의 남중국해 영유권 주장에 근거가 없다고 판결했지만, 중국은 이를 인정하지 않은 채 자체 영해 개념에 해당하는 ‘구단선(九段線)’을 남중국해에 긋고 수역 대부분에 대한 영유권을 주장하고 있다. 루비오는 페르디난드 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령과 만나 ‘철통(ironclad)’ 같은 동맹, 남중국해에서의 항행(航行)·상공 비행의 자유 중요성 등을 강조했다. 또 다자(多者) 안보 협의체 쿼드(QUAD) 외교장관과도 만나 이 문제를 논의했다.)

The State Department's spokesperson statement indicated that the three ministers "emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait." It also said they "expressed concern" over China's recent launch of an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) into the Pacific with insufficient prior notice. This launch provoked strong backlash from Japan, Australia, and others, but South Korea, geographically close to China, only stated a principled position of "closely monitoring." Notably, these points were not included in the outcome press release from the South Korean Foreign Ministry. Regarding North Korea, the State Department statement said, "They affirmed shared commitment to complete denuclearization of North Korea (DPRK) and continued cooperation in responding to North Korean cyber threats and illicit activities, and to work for immediate resolution of the abduction issue." In contrast, the Foreign Ministry used the phrase "principle of denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula," omitting mention of North Korean cyber threats and the abduction issue, and stated they "agreed to continue communication and cooperation through dialogue and diplomacy." (국무부가 발표한 대변인 명의 발언을 보면 3국 장관이 “대만 해협 전역의 평화·안정을 유지하는 것이 중요함을 강조했다”고 돼 있다. 또 중국이 최근 태평양으로 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM)을 발사하면서 충분한 사전 통보를 하지 않은 점에 대해 “우려를 표명한다”고 했다. 이 발사는 일본, 호주 등의 강한 반발을 낳았는데 정작 중국 지근거리에 있는 한국은 ‘예의주시하고 있다’는 원론적인 입장을 표명하는 데 그쳤다. 특히 이런 내용은 외교부가 전한 회의 결과 보도자료에는 담기지 않았다. 북한 문제 역시 국무부 발표를 보면 “북한(DPRK)에 대한 완전한 비핵화에 대한 공동의 의지를 강조하고 북한의 사이버 위협 및 불법 활동에 대응하기 위한 지속적인 협력, 납치 문제의 즉각적인 해결을 위해 노력하기로 한다”고 했다. 반면 외교부는 ‘한반도 비핵화 원칙’이란 표현을 사용하면서 북한의 사이버 위협, 납치 문제에 대한 언급 없이 “대화와 외교를 통한 소통과 협력을 지속해 나가기로 했다”고 했다.)

Earlier this month, on the 10th anniversary of the PCA ruling, the U.S. led a joint statement with Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and other Indo-Pacific allies urging China to comply with international law, which South Korea did not join. The statement also included countries belonging to the "free and democratic camp" in the international community, such as Germany and the UK. Typically, when foreign ministers meet, what each country deems important is specified in press releases, but under the Lee Jae-myung administration, differing U.S. and South Korean statements have become a recurring pattern. The State Department stated that the three ministers "reaffirmed a shared opposition to economic coercion and the weaponization of supply chains while emphasizing the importance of economic security," with phrases like "economic coercion" and "weaponization of supply chains" commonly used when targeting China. (이달 초에도 PCA 판결 10주년을 맞아 미국이 주도해 일본, 호주, 뉴질랜드 등 인·태 지역 동맹국이 중국의 국제법 준수를 촉구하는 공동 성명을 발표했지만 한국은 여기에 불참한 것으로 나타났다. 이 성명에는 독일, 영국 등 국제 사회에서 ‘자유·민주 진영’에 속하는 나라들이 이름을 올렸다. 통상 외교장관 회담을 하면 각국이 중요하게 생각하는 것을 보도자료에 적시하는데, 이재명 정부 들어선 한미 간 발표가 상이한 모습이 반복되고 있다. 국무부는 3국 장관이 “경제 안보의 중요성을 강조하면서 경제적 강압 및 공급망의 무기화에 대한 공동의 반대 입장을 재확인했다”고 밝혔는데, ‘경제적 강압(economic coercion)’과 ‘공급망 무기화(weaponization of supply chains)’는 중국을 겨냥할 때 단골로 등장하는 문구다.)

Meanwhile, meeting with reporters, Rubio was asked whether the U.S. has requested Asian allies, including South Korea, to contribute naval assets in the Strait of Hormuz. He replied, "We did not make that request today, but they heavily rely on oil and natural gas supplied from (the Middle East), and I think doing so would benefit them." Rubio added, "We've had those conversations in the past, and each country has different constraints to go through for approval. I think it would be beneficial if they did. Some of these countries have special capabilities in mine clearance or similar areas." <<>> (한편 루비오는 이날 기자들과 만나 ‘미국이 한국 등 아시아 동맹에 호르무즈 해협에 대한 해군 자산 등의 기여를 요청했냐’는 질문에 “오늘 그런 요청을 하지 않았다”면서도 “그들은 (중동에서) 공급되는 석유와 천연가스에 크게 의존하고 있다. (기여하면) 그들에게 이익이 되는 것이라 생각한다”고 했다. 루비오는 “과거에 그런 대화를 나눈 적이 있고 각국은 이를 승인 받기 위해 거쳐야 할 제약들이 다르다”며 “그렇게 한다면 유익할 것이라 생각한다. 이들 국가 중 일부는 기뢰 제거나 유사한 분야에서 특별한 능력을 보유하고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "JMS's Jeong Myeong-seok is my uncle?... Legal action" (정청래 “JMS 정명석씨가 저의 작은 아버지?...법적 조치”)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea is embroiled in controversy over alleged 'Shincheonji election interference' ahead of the August 17 party convention, Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate for party leader, stated that "(the allegations of Shincheonji involvement) are 100% fake news." (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘신천지 선거 개입설’ 등으로 시끄러운 가운데, 정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 후보가 “(신천지 연루 의혹 등은) 100% 가짜 뉴스”라고 했다.)

In a YouTube channel interview on the night of the 22nd, former leader Jeong firmly addressed the recent Shincheonji controversy, saying, "I have no connection whatsoever to Shincheonji. It's 100% fake news." He continued, "Some YouTubers are attacking me for attending the naming ceremony of the 'Peace Nobel Road' at the Gyeongui Line Forest Park in Donggyo-dong, my district (in June 2019). At that time, the current Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, as well as the head of Mapo District Office and the police chief, also attended and gave congratulatory speeches, but they're trying to tie that together." (정 전 대표는 22일 밤 유튜브 채널 인터뷰에서 최근 불거진 신천지 논란에 대해 “신천지와 아무런 관련이 없다. 100% 가짜 뉴스다”고 단언했다.이어 “제 지역구인 동교동 경의선 숲길 공원에서 (2019년 6월) ‘평화의 노벨길’ 명명식 행사에 참석한 것을 가지고 일부 유튜버가 공격하고 있다”며 “그때 지금 경제부총리인 구윤철 기재부 장관, 마포구청장, 경찰서장도 참석해 축사했는데 그걸 엮으려 한다”고 했다.)

He said, "Looking at the comments now, party members are outraged, asking, 'So if I support Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae, does that make me a Shincheonji follower?' They're demanding, 'Produce the evidence quickly.'" (그는 “지금 댓글을 보니 ‘정청래 의원 지지하는 내가 그럼 신천지 신도란 말이냐’며 당원들이 분노한다”며 “빨리 근거를 대라”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a rival in the party leadership race, claimed, "Shincheonji is interfering in the party convention," and said, "I will release the evidence soon." While he did not specify who specifically the Shincheonji forces are supporting, pro-government YouTubers are spreading rumors about 'former leader Jeong Cheong-rae's involvement.' (앞서 당권 경쟁자인 김민석 전 국무총리는 지난 21일 “신천지가 전당대회에 개입하고 있다”며 “조만간 증거를 공개하겠다”고 했었다. 그는 신천지 세력이 구체적으로 누구를 지원하고 있는지는 언급하지 않았지만 친여 유튜버들은 ‘정청래 전 대표의 연루설’을 퍼뜨리고 있는 상황이다.)

Former leader Jeong stated, "Raising suspicions that 'Shincheonji is trying to exert influence' over the Democratic Party convention is an extremely dangerous claim that could drive the party into being labeled an unconstitutional party. This is more serious than illegal electioneering, so strong punishment and legal action are necessary." (정 전 대표는 “민주당 전당 대회에 ‘신천지가 영향력을 행사하려고 한다’며 개입 의혹을 제기하는 건 당이 위헌정당으로 내몰릴 수 있는 위험천만한 주장”이라며 “이는 해당 행위보다도 더 심각한 사항이기에 강력한 응징과 법적 조치가 필요하다”고 했다.)

He added, "If I am involved (with Shincheonji), don't just suspect me—report me to the police and provide evidence. If you can't, you should apologize." (그러면서 “제가 (신천지에) 연루돼 있다면 의심만 말고 저를 경찰에 고발하고 근거를 대라”며 “그렇지 못하다면 사과해야 할 것이다”고 했다.)

Former leader Jeong also mentioned that false claims are being spread that Jeong Myeong-seok, the head of the Christian Gospel Mission (commonly known as JMS), who is serving a prison sentence for sexually assaulting a female follower, is 'Jeong Cheong-rae's uncle.' He said, "A YouTuber claimed that JMS's Jeong Myeong-seok is my uncle, so I plan to take legal action. I have never met Jeong Myeong-seok, never exchanged a single phone call with him, and don't even know where he lives." Former leader Jeong explained the naming tradition in his family, saying, "My father's brothers all have the character 'Hae' in their names: my uncle is 'Hae0', and my youngest uncle is 'Hae0'," adding, "There are no names with 'Myeong' or 'Seok' in our family." (정 전 대표는 여신도 성폭행 혐의로 복역 중인 기독교복음선교회(통칭 JMS)의 정명석 총재가 ‘정청래 작은아버지’라는 말까지 유포되고 있다고도 했다. 그는 “어느 유튜버가 JMS 정명석 씨가 저의 작은 아버지라고 해 법적 조치를 할 예정이다”며 “정명석 씨와 일면식도, 전화 한 통 한 적 없고 어디 사는지도 모른다”고 했다. 정 전 대표는 “저희 아버지 형제들은 ‘해’자 돌림으로 작은아버지는 ‘해0’, 막내 삼촌은 ‘해0’이다”며 가문의 돌림자까지 설명한 뒤 “명자, 석자 돌림은 없다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok on 'Shincheonji Offensive': "Linking to a Specific Candidate Is Not My Responsibility" (‘신천지 공세’ 김민석 “특정 후보 연결은 내 책임 아냐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok on 'Shincheonji Offensive': "Linking to a Specific Candidate Is Not My Responsibility" (‘신천지 공세’ 김민석 “특정 후보 연결은 내 책임 아냐”)

The Democratic Party of Korea is in turmoil over allegations of 'Shincheonji election interference' ahead of its August 17th party convention. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a candidate in the party leadership election, first raised the issue, but former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae countered, "If you use my name to suggest involvement, I will take the strongest legal action immediately. Present the exact evidence based on the five Ws and one H." <<> Former Prime Minister Kim posted on X (formerly Twitter) on the 22nd, writing, "I will overcome all of it—anti-Moonism, factionalism, Shincheonji, and their collusion," once again referencing Shincheonji. He is claiming that Shincheonji forces are interfering in the party convention. However, he did not specify whom they support or how they are intervening, only stating, "I will reveal the evidence soon." Pro-Moon YouTubers have been alleging "former Representative Jeong's involvement." Meanwhile, Shincheonji posted a statement on its website the same day, saying, "We have no interest in the Democratic Party convention and have not engaged in any interference." <<> In response, former Prime Minister Kim told reporters, "Hasn't Shincheonji previously claimed to do things?" Regarding the evidence of Shincheonji's interference, he said, "Leave it to me." As for claims linking Shincheonji to former Representative Jeong, he said, "I only pointed out the problem of Shincheonji's political interference. I don't think I need to be responsible for connecting it to a specific candidate." However, the previous day, Kim had argued that Jeong, during his tenure as party leader earlier this year, did not include Shincheonji in the scope of the Unification Church special counsel investigation. Pro-Moon lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, a candidate in the Supreme Council election, also posted on Facebook the same day, saying, "We will establish and operate a 'Shincheonji convention interference (mass party membership) report center' and file an immediate complaint if any illegalities are found." <<> Pro-Moon lawmaker Song Young-gil, a candidate in the party leadership election, also argued during a debate with YouTubers the previous day that the 'one-vote system for delegates and dues-paying members' introduced by Jeong was vulnerable to Shincheonji infiltration. He said, "You can just join the party and pay 1,000 won a month for six months to become a dues-paying member. If Shincheonji gets involved in the Democratic Party leadership election or the next presidential primary, what measures can block them?" <<> Former Representative Jeong appeared on YouTube to deny Shincheonji involvement, stating, "I will punish them most severely. They will definitely pay the price." He also addressed former Prime Minister Kim, saying, "Either quickly provide the evidence, or if you suspect my involvement, report me to the police. Then I will countersue," adding, "This is a matter that should prompt all party members to rise up." <<> Pro-Jeong lawmakers attacked former Prime Minister Kim, demanding, "Provide the evidence." Pro-Jeong Supreme Council candidates Lee Seong-yoon, Choi Min-hee, and Han Min-soo held a press conference and said, "If he cannot provide evidence, he should withdraw from the party leadership race." <<> The party leadership candidates also engaged in a power struggle over a suitability poll released the same day. According to a survey conducted on August 20-21 by pollster KSOI of 1,000 adults nationwide, former Representative Jeong received 25.7% and former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok 21.5%, a shift from results two weeks prior. In Gwangju and Jeolla, Jeong scored 34.0% and Kim 23.1%. Jeong said, "I've reversed the trend by leading significantly in Honam," calling it "the public's expression of 'you're not it.'" However, Kim's camp countered, "In the party leadership election, the vote of party members is key." Among Democratic supporters, Kim led with 36.1% compared to Jeong's 32.6%. (For details, refer to the Central Election Poll Review Committee website.) (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘신천지 선거 개입설’로 시끄럽다. 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 처음 제기했는데 정청래 전 대표는 “만약 제 이름을 대고 연루설을 제기하는 순간 가장 강력한 방법으로 법적 조치하겠다”며 “육하원칙에 의해 정확하게 근거를 대라”고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min Keeps Targeting Lee… Within Party: "A Warning Against the Reality of Charges Being Dropped" (계속 李 저격하는 유시민… 與내부 “공소취소 현실화에 대한 경고”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min Keeps Targeting Lee… Within Party: "A Warning Against the Reality of Charges Being Dropped" (계속 李 저격하는 유시민… 與내부 “공소취소 현실화에 대한 경고”)

Yoo Si-min, who positions himself as a pro-government speaker, has been sharply criticizing President Lee Jae-myung day after day. On the surface, he targets the President's pragmatic line and expansion of appeal to embrace moderates and conservatives through arguments of "rebuilding" and "inevitable defeat." However, Democratic Party figures close to Yoo stated on the 22nd that the real reason for his harsh words toward a president who has just entered his second year in power is "a warning against the movement to drop charges in the President's case led by the pro-Lee faction." They explained that the ultimate goal of the traditional pro-government support base, represented by Yoo, is the re-election of the administration, and if the dropping of charges—which would effectively end the President's ongoing trial—becomes a reality, they believe it would lead to an inevitable defeat in both the next general election and the presidential election. <<> Appearing on a YouTube channel on the night of the 21st, Yoo said, "The actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' are not a riot staged by the 'self-proclaimed pro-Lee faction,' but something planned and initiated by the President and some aides we don't know well shortly after taking office." He added, "It's highly likely that President Lee is the head of 'New Lee Jae-myung.'" When asked why he criticizes a president who has only been in office for a year, he replied, "Even a fish shop selling the best quality fish will inevitably smell fishy," and "If you leave that without any criticism or restrictions, every fish shop will end up reeking." He also said, "Democracy is a system that prevents even evil and bad people from doing as they please when they become the highest authority." <<> Yoo also strongly criticized the cautious stance spreading within the Democratic Party against the complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers. "I think this is the President's intention," he said. Claiming there have been signs of backtracking on prosecution reform since last fall, he stated, "My hypothesis is that the President wants to preserve prosecutors' investigative powers," and "The President hasn't given up on this even now." Yoo did not mention why the President might want to retain these supplementary investigation powers. However, supporters commented, "Isn't it because of the dropping of charges?" This revives the "prosecution reform and dropping of charges deal theory" first raised earlier this year on a pro-government YouTube channel hosted by Kim Eo-jun. Cheon Ho-seon, a former senior presidential secretary who worked with Yoo in the Roh Moo-hyun administration, also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Has the President broken principles and promises, making deals and compromises out of concern for his own well-being after leaving office?" and "It has now come to a point where the President needs to speak up." <<> Democratic Party figures close to Yoo said, "Yoo just doesn't mention the dropping of charges because it's like touching a raw nerve, but his inner concerns are about that very issue." Yoo, while appearing on the pro-government YouTube show "Maebul Show," also said, "The President must be prevented from meddling with 'Myung-pick' [Lee's preferred candidates]. But there have been many instances of such interference." One Democratic Party lawmaker remarked, "The reason the President keeps sending the message that 'Kim Min-seok should be the next Democratic Party leader,' despite controversy over his interference in party affairs, is likely because he needs a close associate as party leader to strengthen the push for dropping the charges." A key pro-government source said, "Yoo already witnessed the backlash against dropping charges during the June local elections, so he believes that if the new party leader pushes for it again, approval ratings will plummet, ruining the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election." Before the local elections, the Democratic Party had pushed for a special counsel probe into the alleged fabricated indictment related to the President's case, but backtracked due to backlash. Pro-Lee lawmakers are now saying, "If former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok becomes party leader, he will revive the special counsel push." <<> The pro-Lee faction has strongly criticized Yoo, calling him a "traitor." Kim Min-seok, the former Prime Minister and a party leadership candidate, said that day, "Politics that distorts and twists the President's own words and sincerity, crossing the line of commentary, has also lost its restraint and dignity," adding, "False prophecies predicting the failure of the Lee Jae-myung administration will fail again this time." Lawmaker Lim Mi-ae, who is running for a Supreme Council seat while backing Kim for party leader, said on SBS Radio, "I wondered why he had to bring this up again at this particular time." She added, "With the preliminary primary [cutoff] underway, I think this is a very cleverly timed message to rally a specific support base and get them to vote." <<> One pro-Lee figure said, "It sounds absurd to hear the old mainstream factions of the Democratic Party—the pro-Roh and pro-Moon groups represented by Yoo—telling the President, 'This is our party, don't interfere anymore.'" However, Yoo has recently told those around him, "I am not a person who will pursue politics. I was someone who said we should move forward together centered on Lee Jae-myung during the last presidential election. Everything I say comes from a sincere desire for President Lee to succeed in his re-election bid." The presidential office is not directly responding to Yoo's remarks. <<> The rift within the pro-government camp appears to be accelerating ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention. With the new mainstream pro-Lee faction backing former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok for the next party leader, and the pro-Roh and pro-Moon support base backing former Representative Chung Chung-rae, tensions between the two sides are escalating. One lawmaker whose constituency is in the Honam region said, "If they keep fighting each other like this to the death, depending on who becomes party leader, a split within the party is even possible." Some have also suggested, "Isn't Yoo's antagonism toward the pro-Lee faction part of a larger plan to position former Justice Minister and former Rebuilding Korea Party leader Cho Kuk, who is close to the pro-Moon and pro-Roh factions, as the next presidential candidate?" (친여 스피커를 자처하는 유시민씨가 연일 이재명 대통령을 강도 높게 비판하고 있다. 표면적으로는 ‘재건축론’ ‘필패론’을 내세워 이 대통령의 중도·보수까지 껴안는 외연 확장, 실용주의 노선을 겨냥한 것이다. 하지만 유씨와 가까운 더불어민주당 인사들은 22일 유씨가 정권 2년 차로 갓 접어든 대통령을 향해 독설을 퍼붓는 진짜 이유에 대해 “친명이 주도하는 대통령 사건 공소취소 움직임에 대한 경고”라고 입을 모았다. 유씨로 대변되는 여권 전통 지지층의 절대적 목표는 정권 재창출인데, 대통령 재판을 없애는 공소취소가 현실화될 경우 차기 총선은 물론 대선도 필패한다고 본다는 얘기다.)

item.title: Former White House Chief of Staff: "South Korean Government Treats U.S. Companies Like Piggy Banks… Alliance Unviable" (트럼프 前비서실장 “한국 정부, 美기업을 저금통 취급… 동맹 지속 안 돼”)
item.description:
Mark Meadows, who served as White House chief of staff during the first Trump administration, argued on the 22nd regarding the Coupang incident—which has been a stumbling block in South Korea-U.S. bilateral relations for over six months—that "the South Korean government should not treat U.S. tech companies like bottomless piggy banks." He claimed that if the double standard of granting "leniency" to South Korean companies in the U.S. while imposing penalties on U.S. companies in South Korea continues, "no alliance can endure." Meadows, a former four-term congressman and member of the hardline Freedom Caucus, is considered a figure who spearheaded the radicalization of the Republican Party in the mid-2010s. Though now out of frontline politics, his remarks represent the perspective of the MAGA (Make America Great Again) camp on the Coupang situation. (트럼프 1기 정부 출신으로 백악관 비서실장을 지낸 마크 메도우스는 22일 반년 넘게 한미 양자(兩者) 관계의 장애물로 작용하고 있는 쿠팡 사태 관련 “한국 정부가 미 테크 기업들을 끝없는 저금통(bottomless piggy bank)처럼 취급해서는 안 된다”며 미국 내 한국 기업에는 ‘관용’을 베풀고 한국 내 미 기업에 대해선 처벌을 가하는 ‘이중 잣대’가 지속되면 “어떤 동맹도 지속될 수 없다”고 주장했다. 메도우스는 4선(選) 하원의원 출신으로 강성 모임인 ‘프리덤 코커스’ 소속으로 활동하며 2010년대 중반 공화당의 급진화를 주도했다는 평가를 받는 인물이다. 현재는 일선에서 물러났지만, 그의 주장은 쿠팡 사태를 보는 매가(MAGA·미국을 다시 위대하게) 진영의 시각을 대변하고 있다.)

In an op-ed published on the conservative online media outlet Daily Caller, Meadows stated, "The South Korea-U.S. alliance is indispensable, but it is quietly eroding the foundation of mutual trust behind the scenes." He noted that following a raid by immigration authorities on a Hyundai Motor and LG Energy Solution plant in Georgia last year, "Washington accepted Seoul's request for leniency to maintain a cooperative partnership." "The outraged South Korean government condemned the enforcement as a 'betrayal,' and the U.S., as a good-faith ally, accepted the concession," he wrote. In contrast, he claimed that after a personal information leak incident at Coupang, "despite U.S. authorities expressing concerns over an imbalanced and politicized response, Seoul (South Korea's government) intensified its enforcement." (메도우스는 이날 보수 성향 온라인 매체 ‘데일리 콜러’에 기고한 글에서 “한미 동맹은 없어서 안 될 관계지만 뒤편에서 상호 신뢰 기반을 조용히 훼손하고 있다”며 이같이 주장했다. 그는 지난해 조지아주(州)의 현대차·LG에너지솔루션 공장에 대한 이민 당국의 급습 이후 “워싱턴이 협력적 파트너십을 유지하기 위해 한국 정부의 관용 요청을 수용했다” “격분한 한국 정부는 단속을 ‘배신’이라 규탄했고, 미국은 선의의 동맹으로 양보를 받아들였다”고 했다. 반면 쿠팡에서 개인 정보 유출 사고가 불거지고 난 뒤 “미 당국이 불균형적이고 정치화된 대응에 우려를 표명했음에도 불구하고 서울(한국) 정부가 단속을 강화했다”고 주장했다.)

Regarding the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) imposing a record fine of about 625 billion won, Meadows asserted, "That was just the beginning. The Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) and ten other agencies launched over 40 investigations, with the South Korean government waging an all-out war against Coupang." An interim report released by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee shows that during Coupang's recall of laptops linked to a personal information leak in China, close communication occurred between the company and the South Korean government. This contradicts the government's claim of "no directives or coercion." Meadows said, "Shortly after Coupang engaged in a risky joint operation with the South Korean government, regulatory authorities pressured for criminal charges against the CEO. The South Korean government later denied involvement in the operation, which is not how an ally should behave." (메도우스는 개인정보보호위원회(PIPC)가 역대 최고 수준인 약 6250억원의 과징금을 부과한 것 관련 “단지 시작에 불과했고 공정위(KFTC) 등 11개 기관이 40건 이상의 조사를 개시해 한국 정부가 쿠팡을 상대로 총력전을 펼쳤다”고 주장했다. 미 하원 법사위원회가 발표한 중간 보고서를 보면 쿠팡 측이 중국에서 개인 정보 유출이 문제가 된 노트북을 회수하는 과정에서 우리 정부와 긴밀한 소통이 이뤄진 것으로 나타났다. 이는 “어떤 지시, 강요도 없었다”는 정부 설명과는 배치되는 대목이다. 메도우스는 “쿠팡이 한국 정부와 위험한 합동 작전을 벌인 직후 규제 당국이 최고경영자(CEO)에 대한 형사 고발을 압박했다”며 “한국 정부는 나중에 작전에 관여한 사실도 부인했는데, 이는 동맹국으로서의 태도가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Meadows argued, "If the South Korean government expects Washington to open its markets to South Korean conglomerates, it should not treat U.S. tech companies like piggy banks. Friendship is based on reciprocity." He added, "As long as there is a double standard of granting leniency to South Korean companies in the U.S. while imposing imbalanced penalties on U.S. companies in South Korea, no alliance can endure." Earlier, not only the House but also Vice President J.D. Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and members of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) had repeatedly called on South Korea to resolve the Coupang incident. There is a perception in U.S. political circles that while signals for reconciliation and negotiations have been conveyed multiple times, the South Korean government has failed to provide proper feedback. A senior official familiar with the House Judiciary Committee's investigation recently told this newspaper, "The South Korean government's response fails to adequately address the facts we have confirmed. If they dismiss the report as 'meritless,' the situation will only worsen." (메도우스는 “한국 정부가 워싱턴(미국)이 한국 대기업들에 시장을 개방해주기를 기대한다면 미 테크 기업을 저금통처럼 취급해서는 안 된다”며 “우정은 상호성을 전제로 하는 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “미국 내에서는 한국 기업에 관용을 베풀고, 한국 내에서는 미국 기업에 대한 불균형적인 처벌을 가하는 이중 잣대를 적용하는 한 어떤 동맹도 지속될 수 없다”고 했다. 앞서 하원뿐만 아니라 J D 밴스 부통령, 마코 루비오 국무장관, 공화당 연구위원회(RSC) 소속 의원 등이 잇따라 한국에 쿠팡 사태 해결을 요구해 왔다. 미 조야(朝野)에서는 이런 화해 및 담판 의지가 여러 차례 전달됐지만 우리 정부가 제대로 된 피드백을 주지 않고 있다고 인식하고 있다. 하원 법사위 조사 사정에 밝은 한 고위 인사는 최근 본지에 “한국 정부 대응은 우리가 확인한 사실을 제대로 다루지 못하고 있다”며 “보고서를 ‘쓸모없는(meritless)’ 것으로 일축하면 상황은 더 악화할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee to tour US, South America, Germany… to meet Jensen Huang and Altman (李, 美·남미·독일 순방… 젠슨 황·올트먼 만난다)
item.description:
Lee to tour US, South America, Germany… to meet Jensen Huang and Altman (李, 美·남미·독일 순방… 젠슨 황·올트먼 만난다)

President Lee Jae-myung will embark on an 11-day overseas trip from the 24th to next month's 3rd, visiting San Francisco in the US, followed by three South American countries—Brazil, Chile, and Argentina—and Germany in sequence. (이재명 대통령이 24일부터 다음 달 3일까지 11일간 미국 샌프란시스코를 거쳐 남미의 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나 등 3국, 독일을 차례로 방문하는 순방에 나선다.)

On the 24th, the first stop of the tour, President Lee will meet in San Francisco with Dario Amodei (CEO of Anthropic), Sam Altman (CEO of OpenAI), Jensen Huang (CEO of NVIDIA), and Hock Tan (CEO of Broadcom). Cheong Wa Dae Policy Office Director Kim Yong-beom stated, "We plan to secure tangible outcomes such as investments and cooperation from key companies in the global AI supply chain." << (이 대통령은 24일 순방 첫 방문지인 샌프란시스코에서 다리오 아모데이 앤스로픽 CEO, 샘 올트먼 오픈AI CEO, 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO, 혹 탄 브로드컴 CEO를 차례로 만난다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이에 대해 “글로벌 AI 공급망의 핵심 기업으로부터 투자·협력 등 실질적인 성과를 이끌어낼 계획”이라고 말했다.)
